abstract: Language reference for Gecko (.gk) — a Go-based systems language compiled from the go1.28 dev cycle with the simd experiment. Covers native print/println/input, null (not nil), declare-or-assign with = (no :=), colon type annotations, mandatory parentheses, while, classes + new, the export keyword (not capitalization), TypeScript-style imports, template strings, dynamic arrays/maps, null-safe printing, gpm package management, and the simd-enabled toolchain.
